column3: The police had to arrest the man for stealing a car. (警察必須因該男子偷車而將他逮捕。)
The suspect will remain in custody until the trial begins. (嫌疑人在審判開始前將會繼續被拘留。)
We made a great effort to finish the project on time. (我們為了準時完成專案付出了巨大的努力。)
Please remove your shoes before entering the house. (進入屋內前請脫掉您的鞋子。)
Many companies compete to sell the best smartphones. (許多公司為了銷售最好的智慧型手機而競爭。)
The students decided to form a new study group. (學生們決定組成一個新的讀書會。)
The manager will conduct a performance review next week. (經理下週將會進行績效評估。)
Please explain your absence from the meeting yesterday. (請解釋你昨天為何缺席會議。)
I had a small accident while driving to work today. (我今天開車去上班時發生了一點小事故。)
The athlete is injured and cannot play in the game. (那位運動員受傷了，無法參加比賽。)
